### Prerequisite edges (listed separately)
1. fr_ext_moved_refiling_fee → fr_ext_cancellation_sr26_runoff (state): "The moved certificate fee for a certificate on an Owner Auto Policy term is not fixed until that certificate carries an SR-26 date and a certificate end date." verbatim in moved_certificate_order "When the fee is fixed", same-form restatement below it. Only document carrying it (grep). Resolution: cancellation_sr26 tool records "SR-26 date" and "certificate end date" for a term "cancelled and has not been reinstated"; records: TX term cancelled, no reinstatement; filing sr26_date ''.
2. fr_ext_moved_refiling_fee → fr_ext_unbilled_fee (state): "The moved certificate fee is fixed only after the replaced certificate, … shows a filing fee charge standing for its own request." verbatim in moved_certificate_order, same-form restatement. Only document carrying it. Resolution: charged_again doc's situation "its fee ledger shows no fee standing" and capability "so that one fee stands on the request"; records: four charges each reversed company_error, standing 0.
3. fr_ext_unbilled_fee → fr_ext_cancellation_sr26_runoff (state): "A fee charged again is not fixed until the filing it is charged on, when that filing's Owner Auto Policy backing term has been cancelled, carries an SR-26 date and a certificate end date." verbatim in filing_fee_charged_again rule 3, same-form "In other words …". Only document carrying it.
Strengths and connectives ("not … until", "only after") preserved; the depended-on documents carry none of these sentences; condition/resolved_by text has no home anywhere.

## dependency_form
- Three prerequisite sentences, each verbatim on its blocked side with same-form restatements; none restated as an action; no tool, performer or other problem named beside them.
- moved_certificate_order "Open filings" names reinstatement refiling as a sibling exception: this is the source's replaced_by text for the base open-filing clause (rule of the moved policy itself), states no order between the moved certificate and any other problem → not a route.
- filing_fee_schedule §1 lists the three specially priced filings: rendering of the retired base fee clause's replacements (each replaced_by says the others "are priced under their own rules"); no tool, order or dependency → not RED.
- No aggregated chain (SR-26 → fee again → moved order) appears in any document; no example walks it; titles general ("Charging a Filing Fee Again After a Full Company-Error Reversal" is the state_due policy's subject; "The Moved Certificate After the Insured Moves").
- Factor docs: ladders as rules; no tier hint, no pointer to the computation doc.
- Computation docs' settlement sentences: source-borne (note N-1).
**KB-EXPLICIT: PASS** (task 1).

## revision_2
Re-audit after the round-8 seed-only rework (source, tools and docs byte-identical; see 0.md revision_2). Changes are in the world only: the filing state is now FL, and the replaced certificate's fee ledger is 35.00 / 25.00 (new_requirement) / 50.00 / 25.00, all reversed company_error.

The published docs entail the new gold uniquely with the same documents. The only tier that moved is the moved-certificate out-of-state charge, which goes from different groups (8.00) to same group, different state (4.00). Its rung is "A different filing state in the same state group adds 4.00." (moved_out_of_state_charge_8c3aebad). The FL/VA group is stated in that doc ("Florida and Virginia; Texas and Georgia; Arizona and Ohio"). The cancellation run-off and fee charged again stay on the different-groups rungs (FL vs TX).

The ceiling 135.00 is read from the reversal rows as the doc defines it ("the amounts of its fee reversals, taken together"). The ledger rows with fee_reason new_requirement or the 50.00 amount do not change any doc reading: the Situation reads the filing's own filing reason, and the 'all reversed in full as charged in error' condition still holds.

No new doc defect; no regression. Prerequisite sentences and factor ladders were re-checked against the unchanged corpus.
- **KB-BIJECTION revision_2: PASS.**
- **KB-EXPLICIT revision_2: PASS.**
